Subject: Post-demo recap + ask: finance sponsor intro and procurement path

Hi Maya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call highlights (30m):
- Use case: clinicians triaging high-volume patient notes to surface alerts; target throughput 50–100 reqs/sec, median latency target <200ms.
- Key success criteria: false positive rate <5% on alerts; ability to host inference in VPC (HIPAA considerations); predictable per-token unit cost.
- Current blockers: procurement and finance approval; legal needs SOC2 evidence and data residency statement.

To move to a pilot we need two intros from your side:
1) Finance sponsor / budget owner (who signs POs or approves pilot spend) — we can tailor pricing and pilot duration around their constraints.
2) Procurement contact for contract timing and standard terms (NDA/SOW/PO cadence).

I promised to share a short evaluation pack and an LOE worksheet to estimate run rates for a 3-month pilot — attaching both. If you can introduce the finance sponsor (or share an internal name), I’ll draft a one-page commercial summary they can review.

Proposed next steps:
- Maya: intro to finance sponsor + procurement (by EOD Wed 11/4)
- Redwood: send commercial summary + estimated LOE (by Thu 11/5)
- Schedule a 30-min intro between finance sponsor, procurement and our reps (Ben + Karthik)

Attachment: Redwood-EvalPack.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
Attachment: LOE-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

Thanks — Olga
